title: Story premise ENT004: The Pocket Full of Applause
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (physical comedy). Hook: I brought my own applause. It escaped. Takeaway/theme: Timing can matter more than volume.
description: A nervous speaker wants to save a little applause for later by stuffing visible clap-shaped sound marks into a pocket. The marks spring out at awkward moments until the speaker empties them into a jar, which opens during the final bow and gives one satisfyingly timed ovation.
